architecture.summary: The complete candidate keeps the optional hosted PostgreSQL settings boundary from S2-01a and separates it from internal diagnostics. System logs now belong to src/logs/system, with SystemLog at application, MCP, HTTP and CLI boundaries; ConsoleSystemLogger and OtelSystemLogger retain source location, severity and output behavior. Audit logs belong to src/logs/audit: the moved private settings store/runtime keep their SQL, revision and lifetime behavior. A new AuditLog/AuditLogger foundation exposes only toolCompleted and administrationChanged, projects named nested fields, adds no source location/stack and catches synchronous sink failures. Its metadata-only API has no production caller/exporter; S2-03a must add redacted bounded tool inputs/results before capture. No system stream is exposed to customers and no log viewer is added. Component rules split the former logging owner into system-logs and audit-logs, declare their exact imports and forbid dependencies between them. The registry shows current wiring versus the unwired audit API. No external auth/MCP/SQL behavior or deployment topology changes beyond parent S2-01a; no live migration or rollout. T2 review covers the new component and event contract, plus the retained parent datastore boundary. No ADR is added.
